senses.en_definition: Originating from another country or region; foreign or non-local.
Unfamiliar or different from what is usual.
Separate or distinct from others; out of place.

collocations.en: feel out of place even at home

messages.en: It's been a week since you moved. How's the new place? Settling in okay?
At first, everything here felt unfamiliar. I didn't even know where to go for a meal.
That's normal. You've only just moved in, after all. I'll come over sometime and we can find places to eat together.

senses.en_definition: A soldier; a member of the armed forces.
An army or body of troops.

messages.en: I haven't seen your brother in ages. What does he do for work now?
My brother's in the army. He just got home on leave yesterday.
Oh, no wonder I hardly ever see him. If he's free, ask him to join us for a drink.

collocations.en: Oh my gosh, that startled me!

messages.en: Oh no, I left my wallet at home!
No worries, I've already paid. You can just pay me back later.
I got so caught up in this novel that I didn't realize it was already two o'clock.
No wonder you didn't reply to my message earlier. Go get something to eat first.
